abu-dhabi/cambridge-igcse-combined-scien.programmesIntro: The decision that produced a 0653 set placement usually involved two or three alternatives, and Abu Dhabi families often want those laid out before they commit to a tutoring plan. These are the routes that sit alongside it.

programmes.name: Cambridge IGCSE Combined Science
programmes.description: A single award covering all three sciences and producing one grade, with Core and Extended tiers and a practical component. The content keeps the structure of each discipline while reducing depth, particularly in quantitative chemistry and in the more mathematical physics. Candidates sit a multiple-choice paper, a theory paper at their tier, and a practical component, with the exact structure set out in the current syllabus.
programmes.countryNote: Across Abu Dhabi this route is widely used, often as the default for a year group with separate sciences reserved for students intending to continue them. Which route applies to your child was a departmental decision, and the head of science can explain the reasoning behind a particular set placement.

programmes.name: Cambridge IGCSE Co-ordinated Sciences
programmes.description: The double award covering the same three disciplines in greater depth and producing two grades. It takes more curriculum time than the single award, sits between combined and separate sciences in content, and is the usual step up where a department wants broader coverage without timetabling three subjects.
programmes.countryNote: Several schools in the emirate run the coordinated route for most of a year group. Where a family is comparing it with the single award, the question for the department is how much additional timetable time it requires and whether the student is carrying that load alongside their other option choices.

programmes.name: Separate Cambridge biology, chemistry and physics
programmes.description: Three distinct IGCSEs with three grades, each going considerably further than the single award and each with its own practical component. This is the route sixth forms most often expect from students intending to study a science at Advanced Level, though requirements vary and should be read rather than assumed.
programmes.countryNote: In Abu Dhabi the larger British-curriculum science departments offer this route, usually on the island and in the Khalifa City corridor. Students in a combined set who want to move to separate sciences need the conversation early, because the timetable consequences run across both years.

programmes.name: IB Middle Years Programme Sciences
programmes.description: The programme many Abu Dhabi students arrive from, assessed against criteria covering knowing and understanding, inquiring and designing, processing and evaluating, and reflecting on the impacts of science. Students moving from it into an examined syllabus are often strong at investigation and less practised at the timed recall an IGCSE paper requires.
programmes.countryNote: The emirate has a substantial Middle Years Programme population, and the move into Year 10 examined science is a recognised pressure point. A first marked 0653 paper usually shows it clearly: good scientific reasoning, thin precision under time.

abu-dhabi/cambridge-igcse-combined-scien.subjectsIntro: Below is the 0653 content as a tutor plans sessions around it, strand by strand. Each entry names the specific place marks go missing, because the pattern differs sharply between the three disciplines.

subjects.name: Characteristics and classification of living organisms
subjects.description: Life processes, the main groups of organisms and the use of keys. Marks are lost on definitions given loosely: nutrition, excretion and respiration each have a required form of words, and a student who paraphrases collects part marks.

subjects.name: Cells, movement into and out of cells
subjects.description: Cell structures and their functions, diffusion and osmosis. The common loss is explaining osmosis without naming water potential or a partially permeable membrane, which is where the marks are actually attached.

subjects.name: Nutrition, enzymes and digestion
subjects.description: Enzyme action, the effects of temperature and pH, and the human digestive system. Students describe the graph of enzyme activity and forget that denaturation is about a change in the shape of the active site, which is the creditable detail.

subjects.name: Transport and respiration
subjects.description: Transport in plants and the human circulatory system, aerobic and anaerobic respiration. Diagram labelling carries several marks, and students who learn the structures without their positions lose them on a labelled figure.

subjects.name: Coordination, reproduction and inheritance
subjects.description: Nervous and hormonal coordination, reproduction, and the basics of inheritance with genetic diagrams. Genetic crosses need the parental genotypes written out and the gametes shown, not simply the ratio of outcomes.

subjects.name: Organisms and their environment
subjects.description: Food chains and webs, energy flow, nutrient cycles and human effects on ecosystems. Short, predictable question types, and one of the fastest areas in which to recover marks late in a revision programme.

subjects.name: Particles, atoms and bonding
subjects.description: States of matter, atomic structure, ionic and covalent bonding. Explaining a physical property requires reference to the structure, so a high melting point answer needs strong forces between oppositely charged ions rather than simply strong bonds.

subjects.name: Chemical reactions and arithmetic
subjects.description: Formulae, equations, reacting masses and the reduced stoichiometry this award carries. This is where the single-award candidate most reliably loses marks, usually by attempting a multi-step problem without first taking the ratio from the balanced equation.

subjects.name: Acids, bases, salts and the Periodic Table
subjects.description: Acid reactions, neutralisation, pH, and group trends with their explanations. The trends themselves are a mark each; the explanation attached to each trend is where the rest of the marks sit and where answers go vague.

subjects.name: Metals, reactivity and the environment
subjects.description: The reactivity series, displacement, corrosion, and atmospheric pollutants with their sources and effects. Heavily recall-based, which makes it reliable revision for a student short of time or working through a shortened school day.

subjects.name: Motion, forces and energy
subjects.description: Speed and acceleration, resultant forces, energy stores and transfers, work and power. Losses are generally unit handling and the failure to name where energy went, since energy is lost scores nothing on its own.

subjects.name: Thermal physics, waves and sound
subjects.description: Conduction, convection and radiation, wave properties, reflection and refraction. Description marks require a particle-level mechanism, and diagram marks require the normal, the arrows and the labels regardless of whether the geometry is right.

subjects.name: Electricity, circuits and magnetism
subjects.description: Current, potential difference, resistance, series and parallel circuits, and magnetic effects. The largest block of physics marks in the award and the one most often revised, so losses here tend to be circuit reading and arithmetic rather than concept.

sections.heading: One grade, three sciences: comparing the routes honestly
paragraphs: The first thing a family on this page usually needs is a straight comparison, because the three routes are often explained to them in the language of ability rather than the language of timetabling. The single award gives one grade from one subject slot. The coordinated double award gives two grades from a larger slice of curriculum time. Separate sciences give three grades from three slots. The depth of content rises across that sequence, and so does the number of hours the school has to find.

What nobody can tell you from a content list is what a particular Abu Dhabi sixth form will accept. Entry requirements for Advanced Level sciences are set school by school, and they vary. Some will consider a strong single-award grade for one science; others expect the separate qualification. That question has a definite answer and the head of sixth form holds it, which makes it a far better use of an afternoon than reading comparisons online.

The table below sets out the three routes with what each certifies and what to ask about each. Read the last column as the actionable part. A family that walks into a meeting with the department asking those four questions will get a clearer picture in twenty minutes than any tutoring page can provide, including this one.

Our own position is narrow and worth stating. We teach the syllabus your child is entered for. We do not advise on set placement, we cannot change an entry, and we have no view on whether a school's decision was right, because we have not seen the evidence the department has. What we can do is count the lost marks and tell you which strand is costing them.

sections.heading: Biology in 0653: precision, diagrams and definitions
paragraphs: The biology strand produces a particular kind of script. Students understand the material, write fluently about it, and lose marks on precision. A definition of osmosis that does not mention a partially permeable membrane, a description of enzyme denaturation that does not mention the shape of the active site, an explanation of transpiration that describes the movement without naming the driving process: each of these is a good answer missing the creditable clause.

Diagram marks compound this. Labelled figures appear across the strand, and they reward knowing where a structure sits as well as what it does. A student who has learned the parts of the heart as a list often cannot label them on an unfamiliar diagram, and a student who has learned the leaf cross-section from one textbook image is thrown by a different orientation. Practising on unfamiliar versions of the same figure is the whole fix, and it takes a session.

Genetic crosses are the other reliable loss. The marks sit on the written structure: parental genotypes stated, gametes shown, the grid or cross completed, and the ratio read off with the phenotypes named. Students who can predict the outcome and write only the ratio lose most of the question. This is a presentational habit identical to the one that costs marks in mathematics, and it responds to the same treatment.

Because these are precision problems rather than comprehension problems, the biology strand is usually the cheapest of the three to improve. That is worth knowing when a family has four sessions to spend and a student who insists biology is their weakest subject. The mark count generally disagrees, and where it agrees, the work is quick.
bullets: Definitions carry required clauses, not just the right idea
Practise labelling on unfamiliar versions of familiar diagrams

sections.heading: Chemistry in 0653: reduced content, unchanged arithmetic
paragraphs: The chemistry inside the single award carries less stoichiometry than the separate syllabus and a lighter organic section, but what remains is still arithmetic, and arithmetic is where this strand loses marks. Reacting masses, formulae, balancing and the handling of units all survive the reduction. A student who was never fluent at taking a ratio from a balanced equation finds that the reduced content has removed the parts they could do and kept the part they could not.

The recall half of the chemistry is more forgiving and frequently neglected. Group trends with their explanations, the reactivity series, acid reactions, atmospheric pollutants with their sources and effects: all of this is learnable as precise lists, and all of it appears reliably. For a student short of time this is the better purchase, because a list taught in one session and tested cold the following week stays learned.

Explaining properties from structure is the third category and the one that sits between the other two. High melting points, electrical conductivity, the behaviour of giant structures: each has a sentence shape that earns the mark, and paraphrasing it does not. These are not concepts to be understood freshly in the examination room. They are forms of words, and handing a student the right form of words is a legitimate and useful thing for a tutor to do.

In practice the chemistry strand gets split in a plan. The arithmetic goes into spaced work across weeks, because fluency does not compress. The lists and the sentence shapes go into concentrated sessions, often placed deliberately in weeks when the school day is shortened and longer work is harder to schedule.
bullets: Reduced content keeps the arithmetic that causes most losses
Ratios come from the balanced equation before any calculation

sections.heading: Physics in 0653: relationships, units and the formulae that stay
paragraphs: The physics strand is examined on a smaller set of quantitative relationships than the separate syllabus, which makes it tractable. Speed and acceleration, density, resultant force, work, power, efficiency, the wave equation and the circuit relationships cover a large share of the calculation marks available. A student who can identify which relationship a question wants and substitute carefully will collect most of them.

Unit handling costs more marks here than anywhere else in the award. Kilometres per hour converted at the end rather than the beginning, centimetres left in a density calculation, a frequency in kilohertz used directly in the wave equation: each produces an answer wrong by a clean factor with working that otherwise deserved credit. Writing units at every line, rather than adding them to the final answer, removes most of this, and it is a habit installed in one session.

The description side of the physics strand follows the same rules as the separate syllabus. Thermal transfer answers need a particle-level mechanism. Energy answers must name where the energy went rather than saying it was lost. Ray diagrams need the normal drawn, arrows on the rays and labels present. Students lose these marks while being perfectly able to explain the physics aloud, which is why written practice is the only thing that changes the outcome.

The practical component draws on the same conventions across all three strands: units in the table heading, consistent precision down a column, a line of best fit that is not obliged to pass through the origin, a specific source of error and an improvement that addresses that error. Those conventions are taught in a session and they pay in every practical question thereafter.

sections.heading: Where a single-award candidate's marks actually go
paragraphs: A single grade across three disciplines hides the thing a family most needs to see, which is that the losses are not evenly spread. On a marked 0653 paper the pattern is usually consistent: the largest block sits in the quantitative chemistry and physics, a second block sits in description answers across all three strands, and the biology losses are precision rather than content. A student who is told only their percentage cannot act on any of that.

Counting is therefore the first session's work. Each lost mark is attributed to a strand and to a type, and the resulting table almost always surprises the student. Children are reliable reporters of what they find uncomfortable and unreliable reporters of where they are losing marks, because discomfort attaches to difficulty and marks attach to precision. Those two things are different, and the count settles the argument without anybody having to win it.

The practical value is in what it rules out. A count showing eighty per cent of losses in chemistry arithmetic means the four sessions available should not be spent on a general science review, however much more comfortable that would feel. A count showing losses evenly spread across description answers in all three strands means the right work is written answers and command words, which improves everything at once.

Where the count genuinely shows large content gaps across all three strands with weeks remaining, we say so plainly. That is the situation in which more sessions cannot do what the family is hoping for, and the honest advice is to prioritise the recall-heavy areas for marks per hour rather than attempt to cover a syllabus.

sections.heading: Moving between the science routes, and when it is still possible
paragraphs: Families frequently want to know whether a change is available: up from the single award to the coordinated double award, or across to separate sciences. The honest answer is that it depends less on the student than on the calendar and the timetable. A change of route usually means a change of teaching group, a different scheme of work already partly delivered, and an entry that may already have been made with the board.

Cambridge entries close months before the papers are sat. The published key dates for the March 2027 series put final entries on 27 November 2026, well before anyone has seen a final mock, and the June and November series follow the same shape with different dates. A conversation about moving route in the spring term is therefore an administrative one, and the department may have very limited room. The autumn is when it is a real conversation.

There is also a content problem that nobody raises early enough. Moving up a route mid-year means arriving in a group that has already covered material the student has never met, and the gap is not evenly spread: the quantitative chemistry and the additional physics are typically the parts missing. Where a family is considering it, the useful preparation is to audit which topics the receiving set has already taught, which the head of science can supply in a list.

Our role in this is limited and we would rather say so. We can teach the content gap once a school has agreed to a change, and we can mark work that demonstrates readiness. We cannot enter a candidate, advise a department on a set placement, or tell you what your school will agree to.

sections.heading: How a set placement is usually decided in Abu Dhabi
paragraphs: Set placement feels personal to a family and is usually structural. A department has a certain number of science teachers, a certain number of laboratory periods, and a year group of a certain size with option choices already made. The number of separate science sets it can staff follows from that, and students are allocated on prior attainment, option block compatibility and sometimes simply on which block their other choices sit in.

ADEK supervises the licensing and accreditation of private schools in Abu Dhabi and publishes inspection outcomes on a banded scale. Those reports describe provision across a whole school and will not tell you why your child is in a particular science set. For that, the questions worth asking are how many separate science sets run this year, what criteria were used, whether a review point exists during the year, and what the sixth form expects from a single-award candidate.

It is also worth asking what the award actually was designed for in that school's plan. Many departments use the single award deliberately so that students carrying a demanding set of options can still certificate in science without three examination subjects, and that is a reasonable piece of curriculum design rather than a judgement. Understanding the intention changes the conversation from a complaint into a plan.

Where a family concludes that the placement is wrong, the evidence that moves a department is a marked script rather than a strongly held view. That is the same evidence a tutor works from, which is why the first session produces something you can take to a meeting, whether or not any further sessions are bought.
bullets: Set placement follows staffing, laboratories and option blocks as much as attainment

sections.heading: What one tutor across three sciences can honestly do
paragraphs: It is a fair question whether a single tutor can cover biology, chemistry and physics properly, and the honest answer is that it depends on what you are asking them to do. At the depth the single award requires, a well-prepared science teacher can teach all three strands and mark them against the scheme. At separate-science Extended depth, the same claim would be thinner, which is why we match differently for 0610, 0620 and 0625 pages than for this one.

What matters more than breadth is whether the tutor works from the mark count. A tutor who asks the student which science they find hardest and then teaches that one is doing the thing that feels helpful. A tutor who counts the losses, reports that four fifths of them are in the chemistry arithmetic, and then stays on that until a comparable paper moves is doing the thing that works. The second is unglamorous and it is the whole value of the hour.

There are also things a session cannot do, and naming them is part of an honest arrangement. Apparatus handling for a laboratory practical test belongs to the school. Submitted assessed work, where any course requires it, stays the student's own from first line to last, and a tutor comments on reasoning the student has written rather than producing material for them. Official syllabuses, past papers and mark schemes are the boards' copyright: we cite them and link to them rather than redistributing them.

And no grade is promised. A single award result depends on papers sat under timed conditions on particular mornings and on thresholds set after the series by the board. What can be committed to is the process: a mark count from a real script, one strand worked at a time, written work marked against the scheme wording, and a plain statement when the evidence says a plan is not working.

faqs.question: What does the single award in Cambridge IGCSE Combined Science 0653 actually certify?
faqs.answer: One IGCSE grade, drawn from biology, chemistry and physics studied together at a reduced depth. It is not three qualifications and it is not a different kind of science: the structure of each discipline is kept while the depth is cut, particularly in quantitative chemistry and in the more mathematical physics. It occupies one subject slot where separate sciences would take three, which is usually why a school chose it. What it cannot do is demonstrate strength in one named science, because the grade covers all three at once.

faqs.question: How many science grades will my son get from 0653?
faqs.answer: One. The single award produces a single grade covering all three disciplines, which is the main structural difference from Co-ordinated Sciences 0654, where the double award produces two. If you need to know exactly how it will appear on a certificate and a transcript, the school's examinations officer can show you, and the current Cambridge syllabus sets out the award structure. This matters for sixth form applications, so it is worth establishing before Year 11 rather than when results arrive.

faqs.question: Is 0653 easier than taking the three sciences separately?
faqs.answer: It carries less content, which is not the same thing as being easier to score well in. The reduction falls mainly on the parts that students find most demanding in theory, but what remains still includes the arithmetic, the exact definitions and the description answers where most marks are actually lost. A student who struggles with precision will struggle in either route. What the single award genuinely does is free up timetable time, which is usually the reason a department uses it.

faqs.question: Which biology topics does 0653 keep?
faqs.answer: The structure of the whole discipline: characteristics of living organisms, cells and movement into and out of cells, enzymes and nutrition, transport and respiration, coordination, reproduction and inheritance, and organisms in their environment. What is reduced is the level of physiological detail rather than the range. In marked papers the biology losses are usually precision rather than coverage, so the fix is writing definitions out against the scheme wording and labelling diagrams on unfamiliar figures rather than reading more widely.

faqs.question: Does 0653 include mole calculations?
faqs.answer: The single award carries a reduced quantitative chemistry section compared with separate chemistry, and the current syllabus is the document that states exactly what is required for your child's tier and series. What is consistent is that the arithmetic which remains is where most of the chemistry marks are lost, usually because a student attempts a multi-step problem without first taking the ratio from the balanced equation. Fluency with that step is the single most valuable piece of chemistry work for a 0653 candidate.

faqs.question: Which physics formulae does a 0653 candidate need?
faqs.answer: A manageable set: speed and acceleration, density, resultant force, work, power, efficiency, the wave equation and the circuit relationships between potential difference, current and resistance. Most calculation marks in the strand come from those. The current syllabus states what candidates are expected to recall and what is provided, and that document rather than a revision guide is the one to check. Unit handling costs more marks here than anywhere else, so write units at every line rather than adding them at the end.

faqs.question: Will a single science grade limit my daughter's sixth form options in Abu Dhabi?
faqs.answer: It may, and the answer is set school by school rather than centrally. Some sixth forms will consider a strong single-award grade for entry to one Advanced Level science; others expect the separate qualification in the subject the student wants to continue. Nobody outside the school can tell you which applies, so the head of sixth form is the person to ask, and it is worth asking before Year 11 rather than after results. Ask about the grade required as well as the qualification.

faqs.question: Can my son switch from 0653 to 0654 partway through the year?
faqs.answer: Sometimes, and the constraints are the timetable and the entry calendar rather than his ability. A change usually means a different teaching group following a scheme of work already partly delivered, and Cambridge entries close months before the papers: final entries for the March 2027 series were published as 27 November 2026, for example. The autumn term is when this is a real conversation. Ask the head of science which topics the receiving set has already covered, because that list is the gap your son would have to close.

faqs.question: How was my child put in the combined science set?
faqs.answer: Usually by a combination of prior attainment, option block compatibility and how many separate science sets the department can staff and timetable. It feels like a judgement about a child and is often a structural decision about a year group. The questions that get useful answers are how many separate sets run this year, what criteria were applied, and whether there is a review point during the year. If you think the placement is wrong, a marked script is the evidence that moves a department.

faqs.question: Should we hire one tutor for 0653 or three?
faqs.answer: One, at this depth, provided they work from a mark count rather than from the student's preferences. The single award does not require separate-science Extended depth in each discipline, so a well-prepared science teacher can teach all three strands and mark them against the scheme. Three tutors for a single-award candidate usually means three shallow weekly conversations and three times the cost. What to check is whether the tutor counts the losses by strand and then stays on the weakest one until a comparable paper moves.

faqs.question: Which 0653 strand loses the most marks?
faqs.answer: On most marked papers the largest single block sits in the quantitative chemistry, with the physics relationships and unit handling close behind. Description answers across all three strands form a second substantial block, and biology losses are generally precision rather than content. That order frequently contradicts what the student reports, because discomfort attaches to difficulty while marks attach to precision. Counting the losses on a real script in the first session settles the question without anybody having to argue it.

faqs.question: Does the single award count as one subject for UAE equivalency?
faqs.answer: Reporting on the published British-track equivalency requirements states that students must pass five accredited subjects in GCSE or IGCSE certificates at a grade of no less than E or grade 3, with Arabic and Islamic education not counted among the five. How a combined or coordinated science award is counted within those five is a question for the Ministry of Education or the emirate attestation authority rather than for a tutoring provider, and it should be checked on moe.gov.ae for your own case. We describe the process and point to the official channel; we do not perform it.

faqs.question: Will a tutor come to our villa in Al Shamkha for science lessons?
faqs.answer: No. IB Gram does not send tutors to homes anywhere in the UAE; home visits are a service offered only in India. Lessons for Abu Dhabi families run one to one over live video in Gulf Standard Time. For a course spanning three disciplines this works in your favour, because the hard part is finding somebody who can carry all three strands and mark them properly, and from Al Shamkha a visiting tutor would spend a significant part of the booking travelling rather than teaching.

faqs.question: My daughter is strong in biology and weak in physics. Does 0653 average that out?
faqs.answer: The award produces one grade from performance across all three strands, so a weakness in one is diluted by strength elsewhere in a way that separate sciences would not allow. That can work in a student's favour at Year 11 and against them afterwards, because a sixth form cannot see which strand carried the grade. The practical implication for tutoring is that the physics marks are still worth recovering: they are the cheapest available to her, precisely because they are the ones currently being lost.

faqs.question: Which practical paper does a 0653 candidate sit?
faqs.answer: The practical component is set by the centre rather than chosen by the family, and the current Cambridge syllabus sets out the options and what each involves. In either version the skills examined are the same short list: reading instruments, recording to a consistent precision, tabulating with units in the heading, plotting, drawing a line of best fit, identifying anomalies, naming a specific source of error and suggesting an improvement that addresses it. Those conventions can be taught over video; handling apparatus for a laboratory test remains the school's part.

abu-dhabi/cambridge-igcse-combined-scien.closingHeading: Find out which strand is costing the marks
abu-dhabi/cambridge-igcse-combined-scien.closingBody: If your child is entered for Cambridge IGCSE Combined Science 0653 at a school in Abu Dhabi, the first useful step is attributing the lost marks to a strand rather than accepting a single percentage. Send the most recent marked paper, add the statement of entry if you have it, and say which evenings are genuinely free. The free first session counts the losses by discipline and by error type, marks one description answer against the scheme wording in front of your child, and gives you the count in writing. Lessons run one to one over live video in Gulf Standard Time.

intro.heading: The price question, answered first, because nobody else answers it
paragraphs: Three of the six highest-ranking tutoring pages for UAE searches publish no price at all, and two of the three that do quote in US dollars, a currency no Abu Dhabi family transacts in. One of them asks the price question in its own list of frequently asked questions and then declines to answer it. So here is the answer, in the currency you pay in, with the month it was gathered: published UAE rates in October 2026 run roughly AED 45 to 150 an hour at the budget and university-student end, AED 150 to 300 for a qualified subject tutor working online, AED 180 to 500 for an in-home visit once travel is priced in, and AED 200 to 450 or more for an IGCSE or A-Level specialist. Premium named tutors are advertised above that, up to around AED 650.

Those are figures other providers publish about themselves, collected from their own rate pages. They are the market, not IB Gram's price list, and the honest position on our own pricing is that it is discussed on the consultation after a free trial lesson rather than printed on a page where it would go stale.

What matters more than the band is which end of it a Cambridge IGCSE Computer Science 0478 tutor sits at, and why. Computer Science is one of the subjects where the hourly rate genuinely runs above the average for an IGCSE, and the reason is supply. The person you need can explain how a two's complement number works, mark a trace table against the mark scheme, and read a student's own broken Python well enough to find the off-by-one error inside five minutes. Teachers who can do the theory are common. Teachers who can do both are not, and the ones who can set their own rate.

There is a cheerful piece of news hiding in the syllabus itself. The current version of 0478 has no coursework component. Everything is assessed by two written papers, so there is no project to supervise, no portfolio to review across a year, and none of the extended supervision hours that drive the cost of a coursework subject upwards. Families budgeting for 0478 are budgeting for teaching and paper practice only, which usually means fewer total hours than a comparable essay subject.

Delivery is one-to-one over live video, scheduled in Gulf Standard Time around the Abu Dhabi school run. IB Gram does not run home visits in the UAE; in-home tutoring is an India-only service. For a subject taught through code and diagrams that is not a compromise, because the natural surface for both is a shared screen, and it removes the travel component that adds AED 180 to 500 an hour to an in-home arrangement before any teaching has happened.

sections.heading: What the Abu Dhabi market charges, by provider model
paragraphs: A Cambridge IGCSE Computer Science 0478 tutor in Abu Dhabi is bought from one of about six kinds of supplier, and the hourly difference between them is larger than the difference between any two individuals. Two things in that comparison deserve calling out. The first is that the in-home band is not a premium for better teaching; it is a premium for travel. An in-home visit in this emirate is commonly quoted between AED 180 and 500 an hour, and a meaningful part of that is the drive from the island to Khalifa City. The second is replacement policy, which almost nobody asks about and which is worth more than AED 50 an hour. A freelance arrangement has no replacement: if the tutor takes a job in another country in March, your Year 11 candidate starts again from scratch six weeks before the paper. A platform or agency that can reassign a specialist, and hand over the marked work, is buying you insurance that is invisible until the week you need it.

Ask three questions of any provider at any price. What happens if the tutor becomes unavailable in exam term. Whether the quoted figure is per hour or per session, and how long a session is. sections.heading: Why Computer Science costs more per hour than most IGCSE subjects
paragraphs: The rate for this subject is set by a supply problem rather than by difficulty. Three separate skills have to live in one person. They need the theory: data representation, data transmission, hardware and software, the internet and its uses, automated and emerging technologies. They need the algorithmic half: designing a solution, reading pseudocode accurately, completing a trace table without losing a variable halfway down. And they need to be able to look at a student's own program, running and failing, and find the fault quickly enough that the student learns something from the search.

Plenty of teachers have two of those three. A mathematician can handle algorithms and may not know how a packet is routed. A working software developer can debug anything and has never read a Cambridge mark scheme, which is a serious problem in a subject where an answer can be correct and unmarkable. A general science or ICT teacher may have the theory and not be able to read code at speed. The people with all three set their own price, and in a city the size of Abu Dhabi there are not many of them available at 17:00 on a weekday.

This is where online delivery changes the arithmetic rather than just the convenience. In-home tutoring restricts a family to the specialists within a reasonable drive, and the scarcer the specialism the more that restriction costs. A family in Al Reef choosing from everybody who can teach 0478 well is in a better position, at a lower rate, than the same family choosing from everybody who can teach 0478 well and is willing to drive to Al Reef.

One warning about the top of the band. Rates above AED 500 an hour are often attached to a claim of examiner status. Treat that as a claim to be evidenced rather than a credential. Nobody should imply that examining gives access to papers, boundaries or marking decisions, and a tutor who hints at it is telling you something about their honesty rather than about their teaching.

sections.heading: Two papers, no coursework, and what that saves you
paragraphs: Cambridge IGCSE Computer Science is assessed by two written papers in the current syllabus. Paper 1 covers computer systems and Paper 2 covers algorithms, programming and logic. Each runs for one hour and forty-five minutes, each carries seventy-five marks, and each is worth half the grade. There is no coursework component and no pre-release scenario to prepare in advance.

That last fact has a direct effect on cost. In a coursework subject a tutor is drawn into months of supervision: planning conversations, draft feedback, deadline management, and the awkward boundary work of making sure the piece remains the student's own. Those hours are real and they are billed. In 0478 they do not exist. Every hour a family buys goes into teaching, practice and marking, which is why the total number of hours for this subject is often lower than parents expect even when the hourly rate is higher.

The syllabus does still expect practical programming experience, usually in Python, Java or Visual Basic, and that experience is examined indirectly through Paper 2 rather than assessed as a project. The practical consequence is that programming practice has to happen between sessions, not during them. An hour watching a tutor write code is an hour poorly spent; an hour reviewing code the student wrote and broke on their own is the one that moves marks.

Confirm the component structure for your child's exam year on the Cambridge International website. This syllabus has been revised, the pre-release material that older guides describe was removed, and a family revising from a second-hand book may be preparing for a paper that no longer exists.

sections.heading: Paper 2 and the marks that are lost rather than missed
paragraphs: There is a distinction worth paying for in this subject: marks a student never knew, and marks a student knew and did not get. Paper 2 is full of the second kind, and they are much cheaper to recover. A family who understands which kind they are buying back will make better decisions about how many hours to commit.

Trace tables are the clearest example. The student understands the loop. They set the table up with one column missing, or they update a variable a row too early, and by line nine the output is wrong and every subsequent mark is gone. Nothing about the algorithm was misunderstood. The fix is a mechanical discipline — one column per variable named before starting, one row per iteration, write every change even when it looks unnecessary — and it takes two or three supervised attempts to install.

Pseudocode syntax is the second. Cambridge's pseudocode has conventions, and answers written in a half-remembered mixture of Python and Cambridge style lose marks that the student's understanding had earned. Students who write code every day in one language are the most prone to this, because their fingers produce the language they know. A tutor who marks to the published scheme catches it immediately; a tutor who only reads for intent does not.

The third cluster is written precision on Paper 1. Questions about how a process works want the steps in order with the right terms, and a candidate who describes the idea in their own loose words is marked down for an answer they essentially knew. Describing a process in exactly the terms the mark scheme pays for is a trainable habit, and it is the single highest return per hour available on the theory paper.

sections.heading: How many hours a 0478 grade actually takes
paragraphs: Tutoring is sold by the hour and almost never described in totals, which makes budgeting impossible. The table below sets out the scenarios families in Abu Dhabi actually present, with the number of sessions each typically involves and an indicative monthly figure drawn from the published market bands rather than from our own pricing. These are planning estimates from how these blocks usually run, not predictions about any individual student, and no honest tutor will attach a grade to any of them.

The pattern worth noticing is that early and light beats late and heavy, both academically and financially. A fortnightly session through Year 10 is roughly twenty sessions at the quieter autumn end of the market. A rescue starting in January is thirty or more sessions at the tightest point of the year for specialist availability. The second costs substantially more and starts from a worse position.

For context on what tutoring sits alongside, published monthly estimates for weekly one-hour sessions in the UAE market run around AED 240 to 600 at the budget end, AED 600 to 1,200 in the middle, and AED 1,000 to 2,000 or more for specialist exam-year support. Monthly packages advertised in the market include roughly AED 799 for eight online sessions and AED 1,599 to 1,799 for four two-hour in-home sessions. The in-home figure is the one that shows what travel costs.

One caution on tax: do not assume any quoted figure includes or excludes value added tax. Ask the provider directly what the quoted AED number includes, and treat any confident general statement about the UAE tax treatment of tuition, including on this page, as something to verify with the Federal Tax Authority rather than to rely on.

sections.heading: What changes the number in Abu Dhabi specifically
paragraphs: Several things move a 0478 quote in this emirate that have nothing to do with the tutor's ability. Distance is the largest for in-home arrangements: the drive between the island schools and the Khalifa City or Al Reef communities is long enough that a tutor covering it can only teach a handful of students a week, and the rate carries that. Online delivery removes the variable entirely, which is why rates quoted for online sessions do not differ between Saadiyat and Al Shamkha.

Timing is the second. Specialist availability in the evening slots tightens from February as a June series approaches, and the rate advertised in that window reflects scarcity. A family who books a fixed Tuesday slot in September is buying at a different price from a family who starts looking after the January mock, for the same tutor and the same syllabus.

The academic calendar adds two more. The long mid-year break interrupts programming practice, which decays faster than theory, and families who stop entirely often pay again in September for ground they had already bought. The Ramadan term compresses school days and shifts household routines; sessions can move later or to post-Iftar timing, and asking for that is normal rather than awkward.

School fees provide the context families usually want. In Dubai, the Knowledge and Human Development Authority confirmed in May 2026 that there would be no increase in private school fees for the 2026-27 academic year, under an economic incentives package. Abu Dhabi fee regulation sits with its own authority and works differently, so the Dubai announcement is not a statement about this emirate. It is still the right anchor for the comparison most parents are actually making: tutoring is a small fraction of what a private school year costs, and the question is whether these particular hours are aimed at anything.

sections.heading: Paying safely: permits, who you are actually paying, and your child's data
paragraphs: Private tutoring in the UAE is a permitted activity rather than an unregulated one, and the paperwork question is part of the price question. The private tuition work permit was introduced by Ministerial Resolution No. 710 of 2023. It is granted free of charge for two years. Eligible applicants include teachers registered in government or private schools, employees in the government and private sectors, unemployed individuals, school students aged 15 to 18, and university students. Applications are made through the Ministry of Human Resources and Emiratisation, whose service page for the permit lists no fees and a two-working-day completion time.

Individuals offering private tutoring without a permit from the ministry are subject to fines and penalties under the applicable laws. No fine schedule has been published, so any figure circulating online should be treated with scepticism rather than repeated. Separately, a tutoring operation with premises and staff is a different legal animal from an individual tutor and needs its own educational services permit from the relevant authority; nobody should describe a platform or a person as holding a regulator's approval unless the permit number can be produced.

In Abu Dhabi there is a further rule worth knowing before you pay anybody. Professional-ethics rules for private and charter school staff prohibit teachers from providing paid private tutoring to students enrolled at their own school, and the code of conduct attached to the private tuition permit also bars serving students affiliated with the teacher's own school. An offer of your child's own classroom teacher, privately, is a risk rather than a shortcut. Verify the current wording against the authority's own policy document.

The last item on the list is the one no competitor page mentions. Signing up for tutoring means handing over personal data about a minor. Ask what is collected, why, how long it is kept and how to have it deleted, and expect a privacy policy rather than a shrug. Under UAE Federal Decree-Law No. 45 of 2021 on personal data protection this is a real obligation, and a provider who cannot answer it is telling you how they handle everything else.

process.title: Say which paper is the problem
process.description: Paper 1 and Paper 2 fail for different reasons and cost different numbers of hours to fix. If you know the split from a mock, send it. If you do not, the trial lesson produces one, which is a better use of a free hour than a conversation about teaching philosophy.

process.title: Take the free trial, one per student
process.description: A complete session at no charge, no card details taken, no obligation afterwards. Ask for a short timed question set to be marked inside it so that a dated script exists before any money is discussed. A trial spent entirely on talking tells you very little.

process.title: Ask the three cost questions
process.description: What happens if the tutor becomes unavailable in exam term; whether the figure is per hour or per session and how long a session runs; and whether marking of work done between sessions is included. In this subject the marking of code and trace tables is a large part of the value.

process.title: Agree the block, in writing
process.description: A number of sessions, a scope taken from a marked paper, and an end point. Open-ended weekly arrangements drift, and drift is where the budget goes. A six to eight session block with a re-test at the end can always be renewed; it is much harder to shorten something that never had an end.

process.title: Programming practice happens between sessions
process.description: The student writes code alone and brings what broke. Session time goes on reviewing their own failures rather than watching a tutor type. Families who understand this get far more out of each hour, and need fewer of them across the year.

process.title: Review the spend at the halfway point
process.description: Halfway through a block, read the marked scripts and the per-topic record together. If nothing has moved, that is the moment to change tutor or change approach rather than to renew. The record exists so that the decision is yours and not a matter of trust.

whyPoints.title: A published price band, in AED
whyPoints.description: Three of the six top-ranking pages in this market publish no price at all, and two of the others quote in dollars. The bands on this page come from providers' own rate pages with the collection month stated, so a parent can compare before making a single enquiry.

whyPoints.title: Travel priced out, not hidden
whyPoints.description: In-home visits in this emirate are quoted between AED 180 and 500 an hour and a real part of that is the drive. Online delivery removes it, and the saving either buys a scarcer specialist or stays with the family. IB Gram does not run home visits in the UAE.

whyPoints.title: Both halves of the specialism
whyPoints.description: The tutor worth paying for can mark a trace table to the scheme and debug a student's own Python in the same hour. Many can do one. The rate for this subject is set by how few can do both, and online delivery is how an Abu Dhabi family reaches them.

whyPoints.title: Hours quoted as totals, not just rates
whyPoints.description: A session count and an end point, agreed in writing, with the scope taken from a marked paper. Open-ended weekly arrangements are how tutoring budgets quietly double, and a block that can be renewed is easier to control than one that never closes.

whyPoints.title: Claims you can check
whyPoints.description: No examiner status is asserted without evidence, no regulator approval is implied, and no grade is promised. IB Gram holds no accreditation from ADEK, the Ministry of Education or Cambridge International, and says so on the page rather than in the small print.

whyPoints.title: Clear about your child's data
whyPoints.description: Sign-up involves personal information about a minor. What is collected, why, how long it is kept and how to delete it are questions with answers here, which is more than most providers in this market offer.

faqs.question: How much does a Cambridge IGCSE Computer Science 0478 tutor cost in Abu Dhabi?
faqs.answer: Published UAE rates collected in October 2026 run roughly AED 45 to 150 an hour for budget or university-student online tutoring, AED 150 to 300 for a qualified subject tutor online, AED 200 to 450 and above for an IGCSE or A-Level specialist, and AED 180 to 500 for an in-home visit once travel is priced in. Premium named tutors are advertised up to around AED 650. Computer Science usually sits at the upper end because few tutors can teach the theory and debug code. Those are other providers' figures, not ours.

faqs.question: Why is Computer Science more expensive per hour than my child's other IGCSE subjects?
faqs.answer: Supply, not difficulty. The useful 0478 tutor needs three things at once: the systems theory, the ability to read pseudocode and mark a trace table against the scheme, and enough practical fluency to find the fault in a student's own broken program quickly. Mathematicians often have the second, developers the third, and ICT teachers the first. People with all three are scarce in any single city, and scarcity sets the rate. Online delivery is the cheapest way around that, because it removes the geographic restriction.

faqs.question: Does 0478 have coursework, and does that affect what I pay?
faqs.answer: The current syllabus has no coursework component and no pre-release material; everything is assessed through two written papers of one hour forty-five minutes, each worth half the grade. That matters financially. In a coursework subject a tutor is pulled into months of draft feedback and supervision, and those hours are billed. In 0478 they do not exist, so the total hours a family needs are often fewer than for a comparable essay subject even though the hourly rate is higher. Confirm the structure for your child's exam year with Cambridge.

faqs.question: Is an in-home tutor worth the extra cost for a coding subject?
faqs.answer: For this subject the argument runs the other way. The teaching surface is a screen: code, pseudocode, trace tables and diagrams all live there, and a shared screen lets a tutor annotate the student's own work while both watch. An in-home visit in this emirate is commonly quoted between AED 180 and 500 an hour, with the drive from the island to Khalifa City forming part of that. IB Gram does not run home visits in the UAE; in-home tutoring is an India-only service.

faqs.question: How many sessions should we budget for a Year 11 student?
faqs.answer: Around thirty across the year for a weekly arrangement from September, or twenty-five to thirty compressed into five months if the work starts after the January mock. The second is more expensive in two ways: more hours in less time, and higher rates, because specialist evening availability in Abu Dhabi tightens from February as the June series approaches. A fortnightly arrangement through Year 10 is roughly twenty sessions and often removes the need for the Year 11 block altogether.

faqs.question: What is the cheapest intervention that actually works?
faqs.answer: Two or three sessions in Year 9, before the option block closes, to establish whether your child can hold a sequence of logical steps and whether they enjoy debugging. Students who choose 0478 because it sounds modern, and then find it is an algorithms course, make up a large share of expensive Year 11 rescues. After that, the cheapest useful intervention is a six to eight session repair block scoped from a marked paper, with an end re-test and no rolling commitment.

faqs.question: My child understands the algorithms but keeps losing marks on Paper 2. Why?
faqs.answer: Usually trace tables and pseudocode conventions rather than understanding. A trace table set up with a missing column, or a variable updated one row early, produces a wrong output at line nine and loses every mark after it, with nothing misunderstood. Answers written in a hybrid of Python habits and Cambridge pseudocode lose marks the student's knowledge had earned. Both are mechanical and respond to two or three supervised attempts, which makes them among the cheapest marks available to buy back.

faqs.question: Should we pay for 0478 or 0417 support if the budget only covers one?
faqs.answer: Decide on where the marks are being lost, not on the subject names. ICT is assessed partly through practical papers on applications, and local support for it is easier to find and generally cheaper. Computer Science is examined entirely in writing and needs the scarcer specialist. If a marked paper shows practical file-handling errors in ICT and solid Computer Science theory, the money goes to ICT. The reverse is just as common. One marked paper from each settles it in an evening.

faqs.question: Does the price quoted include marking between sessions?
faqs.answer: Ask, because in this subject it changes the value considerably. A large part of what moves a 0478 mark is somebody reading a trace table line by line, or looking at code the student wrote and broke on their own, and returning it with the fault identified. Some providers include that in the session rate; some bill it; some do not do it at all. A quoted figure without this detail is not comparable to another quoted figure, however similar the numbers look.

faqs.question: Is value added tax included in UAE tutoring prices?
faqs.answer: Ask the provider directly what their quoted AED figure includes, and get the answer in writing before committing to a block. The tax treatment of tuition in the UAE is not something to take on trust from a tutoring website, including this one; the authority on it is the Federal Tax Authority. What matters practically is that two quotes are only comparable if you know whether both are inclusive, and whether each is per hour or per session, and how long a session actually runs.

faqs.question: What should I ask to check a tutor is permitted to teach privately here?
faqs.answer: Ask whether they hold the private tuition work permit introduced by Ministerial Resolution No. 710 of 2023, which is granted free of charge for two years through the Ministry of Human Resources and Emiratisation. Eligible holders include registered school teachers, government and private-sector employees, unemployed residents, university students and school students aged 15 to 18. Working without a permit attracts fines and penalties under the applicable laws, and no fine schedule has been published, so disregard any specific amount you see quoted online.

faqs.question: A tutor is advertising at AED 600 an hour because they are an examiner. Is that worth it?
faqs.answer: Treat examiner status as a claim to be evidenced, in writing, for that individual and for the current series. More importantly, examining does not give anybody access to papers, boundaries or marking decisions, and a tutor who implies otherwise has told you something about their honesty. What genuinely raises value at the top of the band is detailed knowledge of the mark schemes and the ability to debug live. Ask for a trial lesson and judge whether you can see both inside the hour.

faqs.question: Can the same tutor cover my child's maths as well, to save money?
faqs.answer: Sometimes, and for this particular pairing it is more plausible than most, because Paper 2 of 0478 and Extended Mathematics draw on the same logical habits. The test is evidence rather than enthusiasm: after six weeks, the marked work in both subjects should show movement. Where it only moves in one, the saving was not a saving. For students on Core maths taking 0478, a short block of algebra and number work is often the better buy before any Computer Science hours at all.

faqs.question: We are in Al Reef and the nearest tuition centre is a 25-minute drive. Does that change the cost?
faqs.answer: It changes the real cost considerably, which is why online delivery matters more in the outer communities than the hourly difference between providers does. A round trip plus a session consumes most of an evening, and in-home quotes to these areas carry the travel loading openly. Online rates do not vary between Al Reef, Saadiyat and Al Reem Island, because nothing is being driven anywhere. For many families here it is what makes a short midweek session possible at all.

faqs.question: What information will you hold about my child, and can I have it deleted?
faqs.answer: Signing up involves personal data about a minor: name, year group, school, the subject and the marked work produced in sessions. You are entitled to know what is collected, why it is held, how long it is kept and how to have it removed, and to a privacy policy that states it. UAE Federal Decree-Law No. 45 of 2021 on personal data protection makes this an obligation rather than a courtesy. Ask any provider the same question; the quality of the answer is informative.

faqs.question: What if no 0478 specialist is available at the hours we need?
faqs.answer: You will be told plainly rather than matched with whoever is free. Computer Science is one of the narrower rosters, and the weekday evening slots in the two months before a June series are the hardest to fill. The realistic options are a waiting slot, a different time of day, a weekend session, or a tutor whose strength is the theory paper when a marked script shows the losses sit there. Quietly substituting a non-specialist would cost you money and gain you nothing.

abu-dhabi/cambridge-igcse-computer-scien.closingHeading: Compare the band before you make an enquiry
abu-dhabi/cambridge-igcse-computer-scien.closingBody: You now have the AED bands, the provider models, the session totals and the questions that separate two quotes that look identical. Use them on any provider, including this one. If you want a starting point rather than a comparison, send the mock result with the Paper 1 and Paper 2 split if you have it, take the free trial, and ask inside that hour for a short timed set to be marked. Sessions run one-to-one over live video to Abu Dhabi in Gulf Standard Time, the scope is agreed in writing, and the marked work is yours to keep.

abu-dhabi/cambridge-igcse-coordinated-sc.tutorsIntro: Tutors matched through this page teach the double award across all three strands and quote against a plan rather than against a vague hourly figure. Before any rate is discussed, the lost marks on a real paper are counted, because the number of hours worth buying follows from that count and nothing else.

intro.heading: Why 0654 quotes in this emirate differ by a factor of four
paragraphs: Ask four providers in Abu Dhabi what they charge to support a Co-ordinated Sciences candidate and you will be given four numbers between roughly AED 150 and AED 650 an hour, with no explanation of what separates them. The spread is real and it is not arbitrary. It reflects whether one tutor covers all three strands or only one, whether written work is marked between sessions, whether the preparation includes the practical component, whether the student is entered at Core or Extended, and whether the hour includes a drive across the city. None of that appears on a pricing page.

Published figures do exist, which is unusual in this market. One provider lists online tutoring from AED 45 to 65 an hour and another from AED 33 to 52; a third lists IGCSE from AED 150 and International Baccalaureate work from AED 200; a UK agency publishes AED 270; a premium service publishes AED 650. A 2026 Dubai cost survey puts in-home one-to-one visits between AED 180 and 350, with independent home tutors asking AED 200 to 500. Monthly packages appear at around AED 799 for eight online sessions and between AED 1,599 and 1,799 for four in-home sessions of two hours.

Those are other people's numbers and they are quoted here with their source, because a tutoring page that publishes a band without saying who charges it is publishing an opinion. They are also market context rather than our price list: IB Gram starts with a free lesson and a plan, and the figure follows from the plan. What the bands are genuinely useful for is calibration. A quote well below AED 150 an hour almost certainly excludes marking. A quote at the top of the range should come with something specific attached to it.

The double award complicates the arithmetic in one particular way. Because 0654 produces two grades from content across biology, chemistry and physics, a tutor is either covering three disciplines or being supplemented by somebody else. Three separate tutors at a mid-band rate is a considerably larger monthly figure than one tutor who can carry all three at the depth the double award requires, and for most families on this page that single-tutor arrangement is both cheaper and better co-ordinated. Where a single strand has collapsed, a specialist for that strand alone can be the cheaper purchase.

There is an Abu Dhabi dimension to the travel question that Dubai pages cannot describe. Journeys here run between the island, the Khalifa City and Al Raha corridor, Saadiyat and Yas, and mainland communities such as Al Shamkha and Al Rahba, and at five in the afternoon a crossing can absorb a substantial part of an hour. In an in-home booking that time is bought at the teaching rate. IB Gram does not send tutors to homes anywhere in the UAE; home visits are a service offered only in India, so the comparison below exists because families are quoted both and deserve the arithmetic set out.

abu-dhabi/cambridge-igcse-coordinated-sc.programmesIntro: The cost of a 0654 plan depends partly on what comes after it, because a student intending to continue a science needs different preparation from one certificating and stopping. These are the routes that change the arithmetic.

programmes.name: Cambridge IGCSE Co-ordinated Sciences
programmes.description: The double award covering biology, chemistry and physics in one course and producing two grades. Candidates sit a multiple-choice paper, a theory paper at Core or Extended tier, and a practical component, with the exact structure and weightings set out in the current Cambridge syllabus. Content depth sits between the single award and separate sciences.
programmes.countryNote: Across Abu Dhabi this route is widely used for whole year groups. For costing purposes the important consequence is that one plan has to cover three disciplines, so the hourly rate matters less than whether the tutor can carry all three and how the hours are divided between them.

programmes.name: Separate Cambridge biology, chemistry and physics
programmes.description: Three distinct IGCSEs with three grades and three practical components, going further than the double award in each discipline. Supporting all three separately at specialist rates is the most expensive arrangement available in this market, which is why families on this route usually buy support for one science rather than three.
programmes.countryNote: The larger British-curriculum departments in the emirate offer this route. Where a family is paying for separate-science support, the published specialist band of roughly AED 200 to 450 an hour applies per subject, and the monthly figure rises accordingly.

programmes.name: Cambridge International AS and A Level sciences
programmes.description: The sixth-form continuation in a chosen science, with heavier mathematics, formal practical assessment and considerably more explanation expected in each answer. Published rates for Advanced Level support sit at the specialist end of the market, and the hours required per term are usually higher than at IGCSE.
programmes.countryNote: Entry requirements are set by each Abu Dhabi sixth form. For a double award candidate this is the question that most affects the value of Year 11 spending, because whether a science can be continued on two coordinated grades is decided by the school rather than by the board.

programmes.name: IB Diploma Programme sciences
programmes.description: Standard and Higher Level sciences with experimental work across both years and an internal assessment that is the student's own from the first draft to the last. Published rates for Diploma support are generally quoted above IGCSE rates by the same providers, with one listing International Baccalaureate work from AED 200 against IGCSE from AED 150.
programmes.countryNote: The emirate has a large IB sector, and families often move a child from a Cambridge Year 11 into a Diploma Year 12. Budgeting for that transition is more useful than budgeting for extra Year 11 hours, because the first Diploma term is where most families find they need support.

abu-dhabi/cambridge-igcse-coordinated-sc.subjectsIntro: Below is the 0654 content organised the way a budget needs it, rather than the way a syllabus lists it. Each entry carries a note on how expensive that area typically is to repair, because that is what decides where a limited number of sessions should go.

subjects.name: Quantitative chemistry and reacting masses
subjects.description: The most expensive block to repair on the double award, because fluency cannot be compressed. A student who cannot take a ratio from a balanced equation needs spaced work across weeks rather than an intensive weekend, and no rate buys a shortcut through it.

subjects.name: Electricity and circuits
subjects.description: The largest block of physics marks and moderately expensive to fix, since circuit reading improves steadily rather than suddenly. Most students have already revised it heavily, so losses here are usually arithmetic and circuit interpretation rather than missing content.

subjects.name: Physics relationships and unit handling
subjects.description: Among the cheapest repairs available. Writing units at every line rather than at the end removes a whole category of clean factor errors, and it is a habit installed in one or two sessions that then pays across both papers.

subjects.name: Thermal physics and transfer
subjects.description: Cheap to improve and routinely neglected, because it is taught early and revised last. Nearly every mark is awarded for a particle-level mechanism, which is a form of words that can be taught and tested inside a single session.

subjects.name: Biology definitions and named structures
subjects.description: The cheapest marks in the award. Definitions carry required clauses, and diagram labels reward knowing where a structure sits. Both respond to written practice against the scheme wording, and both are usually being lost by students who understand the biology perfectly well.

subjects.name: Genetic crosses and inheritance
subjects.description: Inexpensive once the written structure is shown: parental genotypes stated, gametes shown, the cross completed, the ratio read off with phenotypes named. Students who predict the outcome and write only the ratio lose most of the question for presentational reasons.

subjects.name: Group trends and the Periodic Table
subjects.description: Exact recall with a required explanation attached to each trend. Because the explanation structures repeat, two sentence shapes cover most of the group chemistry examined, which makes this one of the highest returns per session in the whole course.

subjects.name: Acids, bases, salts and preparation methods
subjects.description: Moderately cheap. The salt preparation sequence is marked step by step, and the steps students skip are excess and filtration, both of which are learnable in one session and tested cold the following week.

subjects.name: Metals, extraction and the environment
subjects.description: Almost entirely recall, which makes it inexpensive and a sensible use of weeks when the school day is shortened. Extraction questions are marked on named conditions, substances and equations rather than on reasoning.

subjects.name: Description and explanation answers
subjects.description: The best value work in the award, because it improves all three strands at once. Command words set the type of each line, and answers built to the number of marks on offer collect credit that fluent paragraphs do not.

subjects.name: The practical component
subjects.description: Cheap relative to its share of the grade. Tabulation with units in the heading, consistent precision, plotting, lines of best fit, anomalies and specific error reasoning are conventions rather than content, and they can be taught in one or two sessions.

subjects.name: Multiple-choice technique
subjects.description: Often free. Losses here are usually pace and misreading rather than knowledge, and a single session on how to work through the paper, with the arithmetic done on paper rather than mentally, recovers marks at no further cost.

abu-dhabi/cambridge-igcse-coordinated-sc.regionsIntro: For a cost conversation, the thing that varies across Abu Dhabi is journey time, because journey time is what an in-home rate is partly paying for. The notes below give the practical position in each community.

regions.name: Saadiyat Island
regions.note: A short crossing from the island but a long run from the mainland, so a visiting tutor is either local and scarce or travelling and expensive. Online sessions remove the premium entirely and widen the pool to anybody who teaches the double award.

regions.name: Yas Island
regions.note: Journeys here are straightforward outside peak hours and slow at five in the afternoon. In a ninety-minute in-home booking arriving at that time, a meaningful share of what you pay for is the approach rather than the teaching.

regions.name: Al Bateen and Al Khalidiyah
regions.note: Central island addresses with the shortest journeys in the emirate, which is where in-home rates are most competitive. Even here the comparison is about the tutor pool rather than the drive, since the double award needs all three strands covered.

regions.name: Al Raha Gardens and Al Raha Beach
regions.note: Mainland communities with good access and busy activity schedules. Families here most often ask whether a monthly package is better value than paying per session, and the answer depends entirely on whether marking is included.

regions.name: Al Rahba and Al Shahama
regions.note: Northern mainland addresses where a round trip from the island is substantial. These are the communities where the arithmetic of an in-home booking is least favourable and where online delivery changes the cost most.

regions.name: Masdar City and Khalifa City
regions.note: Established and newer communities on the mainland side with large school catchments. Buses arriving after four push sessions later, and a later start is also when city journeys are slowest.

regions.name: Al Maryah Island and Al Zahiyah
regions.note: Apartment living with working parents in many households. Here the value of written marking is highest, because nobody is available to sit alongside a session and check what was covered.

regions.name: Mussafah and Mohammed Bin Zayed City
regions.note: Dense mainland districts where group classes at the budget end of the market are genuinely available. Whether a group works for a three-strand course is a separate question, addressed further down this page.

schoolClusters.city: Saadiyat, Yas and Al Maryah
schoolClusters.note: Newer campuses with smaller year groups, where the double award is often the standard route and separate sciences are reserved for students continuing them. Families here are usually comparing a premium in-home quote against an online specialist.

schoolClusters.city: Al Bateen and Al Mushrif
schoolClusters.note: Long-established island campuses with large science departments running both the coordinated and separate routes. Students we support in these communities are frequently entered for Extended papers, which changes the number of hours a plan requires.

sections.heading: What 0654 support costs in Abu Dhabi, by format
paragraphs: The table sets out the published bands with the provider that published each one, stated as at October 2026. Read it as a map of the market rather than as our price list. Abu Dhabi tracks Dubai closely for online teaching, because the pool of tutors who can carry all three strands of the double award is national rather than local, and a tutor working over video is not constrained by which emirate a family lives in.

The column that matters most is the last one. Two quotes at the same hourly figure can contain very different amounts of work: one hour of live teaching, or one hour plus a script marked against the published scheme and a record of which strands have been tested. The second is closer to ninety minutes of work and it is the thing that changes a grade. Providers at the bottom of the published range are, in our experience of the market, not doing it.

The in-home rows deserve care. The published range of roughly AED 180 to 500 for an in-home visit includes the tutor's travel, and the survey figures do not break out how much of the booking that represents. In a city where an afternoon crossing can take a substantial part of an hour, the effective teaching rate inside an in-home booking is higher than the headline number suggests. The section below works that arithmetic out for Abu Dhabi journeys specifically.

A final note on packages. Monthly offers in this market appear at around AED 799 for eight online sessions and between AED 1,599 and 1,799 for four in-home sessions of two hours each. Those are reasonable shapes, and the question to ask is what happens to unused sessions, what notice is needed to pause, and whether marking is inside the figure or billed on top.

sections.heading: Dirhams per mark: the comparison nobody offers you
paragraphs: An hourly rate is the wrong unit for this decision. What a family is buying is marks, and marks come back at wildly different costs depending on where they are currently being lost. A session spent installing the habit of writing units at every line can recover a clean block of physics marks for the price of one hour. A session spent building mole fluency recovers almost nothing in that hour and needs six more behind it before it shows.

That is why the first session on this page counts the losses by strand and by type before any plan is priced. Once you can see that four fifths of the losses are in biology definitions, physics units and thermal mechanisms, the sensible purchase is obvious and small. Where the losses are genuinely in quantitative chemistry across both papers, the purchase is larger and slower, and we would rather say so at the start than discover it in April.

The table below gives indicative costs per mark using the published specialist band as the hourly figure. The mark estimates are deliberately described as typical rather than guaranteed, because no tutor can promise a specific number of marks on a timed paper. What the table does reliably is rank the areas, and the ranking is stable across students even when the absolute numbers are not.

Used properly, this reorders a revision plan. Most families arrive wanting to start with the hardest topic, because that is what causes the most distress at home. The arithmetic says start with the cheapest marks, bank them, and then decide whether the expensive block is worth the remaining budget. That is a less satisfying conversation and a considerably better use of money.
